title.value: MasakhaNEWS: A Benchmark Dataset for News Topic Classification in African Languages
title.justification: The paper introduces MasakhaNEWS, a new benchmark dataset for news topic classification covering 16 African languages.
title.quote: In this paper, we develop MasakhaNEWS — a new benchmark dataset for news topic classification covering 16 languages widely spoken in Africa.

extractions.description: The paper presents MasakhaNEWS, a benchmark dataset designed to address the under-representation of African languages in NLP research. It covers 16 languages and supports news topic classification with a consistent labeling scheme. Various machine learning models and techniques such as cross-lingual parameter-efficient fine-tuning and few-shot learning are evaluated on this dataset, demonstrating the potential for improving NLP capabilities in African languages.

primary_category.justification: The paper aims to improve NLP resources and capabilities for African languages, which are largely spoken in developing regions of the Global South.
primary_category.quote: African languages are severely under-represented in NLP research due to lack of datasets covering several NLP tasks.

secondary_categories.justification: The main focus of the paper is on language representation and NLP benchmarks for African languages, which does not directly align with other eco-responsible categories provided.
secondary_categories.quote: In this paper, we develop MasakhaNEWS — a new benchmark dataset for news topic classification covering 16 languages widely spoken in Africa.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper seeks to support analyses and utilization of data for African languages, indirectly contributing to the broader access to data needed for various applications.
primary_sub_category.quote: In this paper, we address two problems of lack of evaluation datasets, and lack of extensive evaluation of LLMs for African languages.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The sub-categories provided do not match the focus on NLP tasks for African languages.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: African languages are severely under-represented in NLP research due to lack of datasets covering several NLP tasks.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on creating a dataset for African languages, which doesn't map well to conventional eco-responsible categories.
new_primary_category.quote: In this paper, we develop MasakhaNEWS — a new benchmark dataset for news topic classification covering 16 languages widely spoken in Africa.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The focus on African NLP tasks does not align with traditional eco-responsible sub-categories, and therefore no new sub-category is suggested.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We create MasakhaNEWS — a large-scale news topic classification dataset covering 16 typologically-diverse languages widely spoken in Africa.
